name: a split where the bus turns
about: Way 100 (Main Street, nodes 1-2-3) cut at node 2, with route 1 on it and a turn restriction whose from-way ends at node 3. The piece that reaches the junction is the new one: the route must list both pieces in travel order and the restriction must follow to the piece that meets its via.
